title: 第17章 你的毒，还给你
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
宋芹的后背撞在石壁上，肿胀的嘴唇已经变成了深紫色。

    通用解毒丹的药效正在消退，念毒从她的嘴唇往喉咙深处蔓延，每一次吞咽都像吞了一块烧红的炭。

    她抬头看着刑椅上的林尘，他依旧半昏半醒，缚灵索把他牢牢捆在铁木椅子上，但他的脸色反而比刚才好了一些——嘴唇上的深紫色正在以极其缓慢的速度消退，眼白里的暗紫色血丝也淡了几分。

    混沌圣体在自行排毒。

    她的蜘蛛被他体内的毒雾毒死了，他自己却在慢慢恢复。

    “你的体质……”

    宋芹撑着石壁站起来，走到刑椅前。

    她伸手按在他颈侧，灵力探进去转了一圈——三股毒素还在经脉里纠缠，但火棘丹副作用产生的那股混乱灵力已经比刚才弱了一半，蛛毒和念毒正在被混沌圣体缓慢地分解排异。

    他的皮肤表面还在往外渗极细微的粉末，但速度比刚才慢了，粉末的颜色也从暗紫色变成了浅灰色——毒性的确在减弱。

    按这个速度，最多再过一个时辰，他就能恢复意识。

    但不能等一个时辰。

    陈元随时会回来，唐玉还在门外守着，她自己体内的念毒也在持续扩散。

    等一个时辰之后，她要么被念毒折磨得失去行动力，要么被陈元发现她动了林尘。

    她用肿胀的手指解开了缚灵索的死结。

    暗紫色的绳索从林尘胸口滑落，铁箍上的倒刺在他腕骨上留下一圈浅浅的血痕。

    缚灵索一解开，林尘体内的灵力立刻开始缓慢流转——不是他主动运转的，是混沌圣体在压制解除后自动恢复了周天运转。

    她把他从椅子上拖下来平放在地上，他的呼吸比刚才平稳了一些，胸口起伏的节奏也恢复了正常。

    “我不需要你配合。通脉法加上反哺——我自己来。”

    她跨坐到他身上，双手按在他胸口，掌心贴着皮肤。

    那股霸道如鞭的灵力再次涌出，狠狠抽进他的经脉，将残余的三种毒素撞开一道缝隙。

    这一次林尘的身体没有绷紧——混沌圣体认出了这股灵力，不再排斥，反而主动缠了上来。

    丹田深处涌出的反哺之力顺着她的掌心往上攀爬，一股温热而绵密的灵力流进了她的经脉。

    “对，就是这样。”

    宋芹的声音沙哑而兴奋。

    她开始运转御兽残卷里的灵力引导术，将自己的灵力和他的反哺之力交缠在一起。

    这不是正宗的双修功法——她是用驭兽的方式在引导一个混沌圣体的灵力。

    但混沌圣体对任何形式的灵力引导都有天然的适应性，反哺之力顺着她的引导走了一个周天又一个周天，完全没有排斥反应。

    密室里只剩下两人的呼吸声。

    她的修为瓶颈在反哺之力的冲刷下开始松动。

    筑基圆满那道困了她一年多的屏障，在混沌圣体毫无保留的反哺下裂开了第一道缝隙，然后是第二道，第三道——灵力从缝隙中涌出，往丹田深处汇聚，凝成了一团前所未有的浓厚灵液。

    筑基巅峰。

    只差临门一脚就能破金丹。

    她双手撑在他胸口，大口喘着气。

    筑基巅峰的灵力在经脉中奔涌，比筑基圆满时涨了整整三成。

    她低头看着依旧昏迷的林尘，肿胀的嘴角扯出一个得意的弧度。

    “一次就涨了三成。陈元说你值一枚破境丹，我看你值十枚。”

    她伸手解开他腰间的储物袋，手指刚碰到袋口，脖子上忽然传来一阵奇痒。

    她用另一只手摸了摸自己的脖子——皮肤表面什么都没有，没有粉末，没有红肿，但那股奇痒从脖子蔓延到肩膀，又从肩膀往下蔓延到手臂、胸口、腰侧，像有无数只蚂蚁在皮层下面同时爬动。

    她低头看向林尘的胸口——他胸口的皮肤上不再渗出暗紫色的粉末，反而干净得出奇。

    所有的毒素都跑到了她身上。

    通脉法把林尘体内的念毒顺着反哺的通道引了过来。

    不是从皮肤渗出来的微量毒素，是整个念毒——唐玉扎进他经脉里的两针念毒，全部顺着反哺灵力转移到了她的经脉里。

    蛛毒和火棘丹副作用被混沌圣体自行分解了，但念毒是火毒宗的独门手段，混沌圣体也排不掉——唯一能排掉的方式就是顺着反哺之力转移到离他最近的灵力源头。

    就是她。

    “你把念毒排到我身上了！”

    她顾不上压着嗓子，声音又尖又哑，“你体内的毒素是混在一起没错——但念毒是火毒宗的独门手段，连唐玉自己都不一定能解！你把念毒排到我身上，你自己倒干净了！”

    林尘没有回答。

    但他的眼皮动了一下。

    宋芹没有注意到。

    她正在疯狂地从袖中翻找解毒丹——通用解毒丹只剩两颗了，全部塞进嘴里，但念毒在经脉里发作的速度远超通用解毒丹的压制能力，奇痒从胸口蔓延到小腹、大腿、小腿，每一寸皮肤都在疯狂地发痒。

    她扯开自己的衣领，指甲在锁骨上抓出一道道血痕，血痕深处渗出来的血液竟然带着极其细微的暗紫色——念毒已经渗进血液了。

    她扑到刑椅旁边的石壁前，从墙上挂着的旧剑中抽出一把匕首。

    不是要攻击林尘——她用匕首的刀尖抵着自己的锁骨，划了一道极浅的口子，暗紫色的血液从伤口渗出，滴在石板上冒出细小的白烟。

    她低头看着那些白烟，忽然意识到一个更可怕的问题：唐玉也解不了念毒。

    唐玉只会用毒，不会解毒。

    就算她现在冲出去跪在唐玉面前求她，唐玉也拿不出念毒的解药。

    唯一的办法是——让她体内的念毒浓度降到发作阈值以下。

    而降浓度的方式只有一个：把念毒转移到另一个人身上，就像林尘刚才做的那样。

    她转过身，目光落在林尘身上。

    她的嘴唇肿得几乎张不开，手里握着匕首，刀尖对准林尘的喉咙。

    “把念毒接回去。”

    林尘没有反应。
content_en:
Song Qin's back hit the stone wall, and her swollen lips turned deep purple.
The effect of the general detoxification pill was fading, and the thought poison spread from her lips to the depths of her throat. Every time she swallowed, it was like swallowing a piece of red-hot coal.
She raised her head and looked at Lin Chen on the execution chair. He was still half-conscious, and the spirit rope tied him tightly to the iron wooden chair, but his face looked better than before - the deep purple on his lips was fading at an extremely slow speed, and the dark purple bloodshot eyes in the whites of his eyes were also a little lighter.
The Chaos Holy Body is detoxifying itself.
Her spider was poisoned by the poisonous mist in his body, but he himself was slowly recovering.
"Your physique..."
Song Qin stood up supporting the stone wall and walked to the execution chair.
She put her hand on the side of his neck, inserted her spiritual power and turned it around - the three toxins were still entangled in the meridians, but the chaotic spiritual power caused by the side effects of Fire Thorn Pill was already half weaker than before, and the spider poison and thought poison were being slowly decomposed and eliminated by the Chaos Holy Body.
Very fine powder is still seeping out from the surface of his skin, but the speed is slower than before, and the color of the powder has also changed from dark purple to light gray - the toxicity is indeed weakening.
At this rate, he would be able to regain consciousness in another hour at most.
But you can't wait an hour.
Chen Yuan will be back at any time, Tang Yu is still guarding the door, and the thought poison in her body continues to spread.
After an hour, she would either be tortured by the thought poison and lose mobility, or Chen Yuan would find out that she had touched Lin Chen.
She used swollen fingers to untie the dead knot of the spirit rope.
The dark purple rope slipped from Lin Chen's chest, and the barbs on the iron hoop left a circle of shallow blood marks on his wrist bones.
As soon as the spirit-binding rope was untied, the spiritual power in Lin Chen's body immediately began to flow slowly - it was not him who actively moved it, but the Chaos Holy Body that automatically resumed its circulation after the suppression was lifted.
She dragged him off the chair and laid him flat on the ground. His breathing was calmer than before, and the rhythm of the rise and fall of his chest returned to normal.
"I don't need your cooperation. The method of unblocking the meridians plus feeding back - I will do it myself."
She straddled him and put her hands on his chest, palms against the skin.
That domineering whip-like spiritual power surged out again, violently pumping into his meridians, knocking open a gap in the remaining three toxins.
This time, Lin Chen's body did not tense up - the Chaos Holy Body recognized this spiritual power and no longer rejected it, but instead took the initiative to entangle it.
The power of retaliation gushing from the depths of her Dantian climbed up her palm, and a warm and dense spiritual energy flowed into her meridians.
"Yes, that's it."
Song Qin's voice was hoarse and excited.
She began to use the spiritual power guidance technique in the beast-controlling fragments, intertwining her own spiritual power with his repaying power.
This is not an authentic dual cultivation technique - she is using the method of controlling a beast to guide the spiritual power of a Chaos Holy Body.
However, the Holy Body of Chaos is naturally adaptable to any form of spiritual guidance, and the power of feedback followed her guidance week after week without any rejection at all.
The only sound left in the secret room was the breathing of the two people.
Her cultivation bottleneck began to loosen under the wash of the power of feedback.
The barrier that had trapped her for more than a year after the Foundation Establishment was completed, with the unreserved feedback from the Chaos Holy Body, the first crack was cracked, then the second, and the third - spiritual power poured out from the crack, converging deep into the Dantian, condensing into an unprecedentedly thick liquid.
The pinnacle of foundation building.
It only takes one final kick to break the golden elixir.
She put her hands on his chest and gasped for air.
The spiritual power at the peak of Foundation Establishment surges through the meridians, which is a full 30% higher than when Foundation Establishment was complete.
She looked down at Lin Chen, who was still unconscious, and the corners of her swollen mouth curved in a proud arc.
"It went up by 30% in one go. Chen Yuan said you were worth one Realm Breaking Pill, but I think you're worth ten."
She reached out to untie the storage bag at his waist. As soon as her fingers touched the mouth of the bag, she suddenly felt a strange itch on her neck.
She touched her neck with her other hand - there was nothing on the surface of her skin, no powder, no redness or swelling, but the strange itching spread from her neck to her shoulders, and then from her shoulders down to her arms, chest, and waist, like countless ants crawling under the skin at the same time.
She lowered her head and looked at Lin Chen's chest - the skin on his chest no longer oozed dark purple powder, but was surprisingly clean.
All the toxins ran to her.
The pulse-opening method led the thought poison in Lin Chen's body along the channel of backfeeding.
It's not a trace amount of toxin seeping out from the skin, but the entire thought poison - the two needles of thought poison that Tang Yu inserted into his meridians were all transferred to her meridians along with the regurgitated spiritual power.
The side effects of Spider Venom and Fire Thorn Pill are decomposed by the Chaos Holy Body on their own, but the thought poison is a unique method of the Fire Poison Sect, and the Chaos Holy Body cannot expel it - the only way to expel it is to follow the power of feedback and transfer it to the source of spiritual power closest to him.
That's her.
"You put the thought poison on me!"
She didn't care to suppress her voice, and her voice was high-pitched and hoarse, "The toxins in your body are mixed together - but the poison of mind is a unique method of the Fire Poison Sect, and even Tang Yu may not be able to cure it! You discharged the poison of mind to me, and you poured it out yourself!"
Lin Chen did not answer.
But his eyelids moved.
Song Qin didn't notice.
She was frantically searching for detoxification pills from her sleeves - there were only two universal detoxification pills left, and she stuffed them all into her mouth. However, the speed of the poison in her meridians far exceeded the suppression ability of the universal detoxification pills. The itching spread from her chest to her lower abdomen, thighs, and calves, and every inch of her skin was itching crazily.
She tore open her collar and scratched blood marks on her collarbone with her fingernails. The blood seeping out from the depths of the blood marks had an extremely subtle dark purple color - the thought poison had seeped into the blood.
She threw herself in front of the stone wall next to the execution chair and pulled out a dagger from the old sword hanging on the wall.
It was not to attack Lin Chen - she pressed the tip of the dagger against her collarbone and made a very shallow cut. Dark purple blood seeped out from the wound, dripping on the stone slab and emitting tiny white smoke.
She looked down at the white smoke and suddenly realized a more terrifying problem: Tang Yu couldn't cure the thought poison either.
Tang Yu only knows how to use poison, but not how to detoxify it.
Even if she rushed out and knelt in front of Tang Yu to beg her, Tang Yu still couldn't get the antidote for the poison.
The only way is to let the concentration of thought poison in her body drop below the attack threshold.
There is only one way to reduce the concentration: transfer the thought poison to another person, just like what Lin Chen did just now.
She turned around and her eyes fell on Lin Chen.
Her lips were so swollen that she could hardly open them. She was holding a dagger in her hand, the tip of which was aimed at Lin Chen's throat.
"Take Nian Du back."
Lin Chen didn't respond.
title_en: Chapter 17 Your poison will be returned to you
